name: Publishing Activity Reports
author: Eko Pramono

sections.description:
Publishing Activity Reports adds a report page under Tools in the WordPress admin to help users review publishing activity.

Features:
* Count published standard WordPress posts for a selected calendar year.
* View a monthly publication bar chart and a month-by-month table.
* See the average number of published posts per month.
* Find the most productive month.
* Compare the selected year’s total with the previous year’s total.
* Filter reports by year.

Counts use the local publication date stored in WordPress (post_date), not the last modified date. Only standard posts with publish status are counted; pages and custom post types are excluded. The dashboard is available to users with the publish_posts capability.

The plugin does not use external services, does not collect analytics about visitors, and does not create custom database tables.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the publishing-activity-reports folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or upload the plugin ZIP through Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate Publishing Activity Reports in the Plugins menu.
  3. Open Tools > Publishing Reports in the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Select a year and click Filter to view the report.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin count pages and custom post types?

No. Version 1.0.0 counts published posts of the standard post type only.

Does editing an old article increase the count?

No. Reports use the publication date rather than the last modification date.

Does the plugin send information to an external service?

No. Reports are generated locally using the WordPress posts database table.

Can editors view the dashboard?

Yes. Users with the publish_posts capability can access it.
